name: git_changes_since_base
description: List the workspace changes made since the run's base commit (recorded for the run at task start and advanced with git_set_base), including untracked files: a name-status list by default, one line per changed path, or the full unified diff — with the contents of untracked files — when includeDiff is true. Pass paths to limit the result to specific workspace-relative files or directories. If the workspace is not a git repository, it reports that plainly rather than failing. Read-only.

detailed: Lists the changes made since the run's base commit, as a name-status list or a full diff.
friendly: See what changed since the base.
whimsical: Weigh the delta since the starting line.

friendly: {source} is listing changes since the base
whimsical: {source} is counting the changes since the base

detailed: tool {participantRole} is computing the changes since the base commit
whimsical: Counting the changes since the base

paths.description: Optional list of workspace-relative file or directory paths to limit the result to. If omitted, the whole repository is considered.

includeDiff.description: Optional. When true, return the full unified diff instead of the name-status list; when false (the default), only the name-status list is returned.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
